title: Member Services System Reference: The Settlement Restocking Fee on Northgate Special Order Returns
content:
## Scope of the rule

On a Northgate Purchases & Returns purchase whose presenting membership is a consumer-segment membership (Northgate Student Club, Heroes Club, Club or Club Plus Membership), the restocking on a changed-mind return of Northgate Special Order merchandise is charged as the settlement restocking fee when the changed-mind refund for those units is posted, entered as one restocking fee entry against the refunded sale line. A purchase presented on a business-segment membership is outside this rule.

The settlement restocking fee is fixed only after the changed-mind refund for the units the returns center has logged as received stands on the purchase.

Restated: so long as no changed-mind refund for the units logged as received stands on the purchase, the settlement restocking fee is not fixed.

| Presenting membership | Settlement restocking fee under this rule |
|---|---|
| Northgate Student Club, Heroes Club, Club or Club Plus Membership | charged as one restocking fee entry against the refunded sale line |
| Northgate Business or Business Plus Membership | outside this rule |

## The charging tool: `charge_restocking_fee_79f2f340`

**Capability.** The tool charges a restocking fee on a purchase: member services books, against the refunded sale line given, one restocking fee entry for the amount given, dated today, and raises the purchase's net paid amount by that amount. The fee appears in the purchase's line history pointing at that sale line and is then standing on the purchase.

**How it is invoked.** This is a member services tool: the agent unlocks `charge_restocking_fee_79f2f340` and then calls it on the agent side.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `order_id` | the purchase reference number the fee is charged on, read from the purchase lookup | identifier |
| `source_order_line_id` | the reference number of the sale line the returned units came from, read from the received return authorization (its sale line) | identifier |
| `restocking_fee` | the restocking fee to charge, in USD | a positive amount with 2 decimal places (cents); a value with more decimals is rounded half up to 2 decimal places at booking |

**Return.** A receipt with `fee_entry_id` (the reference number of the new fee entry), `fee_type` (always `restocking_fee`), `amount` (USD, 2 decimal places), `event_date` (YYYY-MM-DD) and `net_paid_amount` (the purchase's net paid amount afterwards, USD, 2 decimal places). The presence of `fee_entry_id` indicates the fee was booked.
